DIAGNOSIS READY: Paraneoplastic Subacute Cerebellar Degeneration secondary to Small Cell Lung Cancer.

The combination of progressive ataxia, gait instability, memory loss, and psychiatric symptoms like paranoia, especially with a lack of prior trauma or stroke, strongly suggests an autoimmune reaction triggered by an underlying malignancy. While the MRI will help localize the cerebellar involvement, these specific behavioral and cognitive changes alongside motor deficits are classic for paraneoplastic syndromes, particularly those associated with small cell lung cancer. We must immediately screen for occult malignancy.

REQUEST TEST: CT Chest with contrast, Anti-Yo antibodies, Anti-Hu antibodies.
